announced on Friday that it extended the contracted lease term for its Barber Lake data center in Texas from 10 to 20 years.
The move lifted the total contracted revenue from $3.8B to more than $9B.
The extension includes a 10-year commitment from a leading AI after the existing Fluidstack lease ends, adding about $5.2B in contracted revenue.
Data halls to begin phased deliveries from from Q4 2026 through Q1 2027, with rent starting as each hall is delivered.
The company will cover the first $359.3M of costs above the original budget, while tenants will reimburse 50% of additional costs above that amount over the 20-year term.
On the market side, the shares traded nearly 3% higher at about $18.68 premarket following the announcement.

title: Cipher Digital doubles Barber Lake lease; revenue tops $9B
